== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use this skill when at least two allied minions are below 50% health.
{{Bug|Heroes take minions of other party members into consideration.}}

== Notes ==
* This skill can be used without any minions. 
* Aside from [[Illusion of Weakness]] when at low health, and the elite [[Blood Is Power]], this is the second fastest skill to kill oneself. [[Order of Pain]] is slightly faster.
{{Bug|The concise description fails to mention that only the caster's undead servants are affected.}}

== Trivia ==
* This skill is named after [[Verata the Necromancer]].
